name: PING: Physicists Inspiring the Next Generation (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend two weeks doing nuclear physics at the FRIB lab with undergraduate mentors. It can turn into a year-long research project. Students may present their work at national conferences.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12. The listing does not state other rules.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the listing I could read.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was March 15, 2026 and the program ran July 12 to 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the listing.
how_to_apply: Use the program page linked from the MSU Spartan Youth listing. Questions: ping@frib.msu.edu.
notes: The FRIB program page (frib.msu.edu) did not load for me because the site blocks automated readers. So this card rests on Michigan State University's Spartan Youth Programs listing only. Confirm dates, the application link, cost and any extra requirements on the FRIB page before you plan. Not a paid job.
